sql: SELECT SUM(total_clicks) AS total_vle_clicks FROM agg_enrollment_week

SELECT 
    p.code_module, 
    SUM(e.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    dim_presentation p
JOIN 
    agg_enrollment_week e ON p.presentation_key = e.presentation_key
GROUP BY 
    p.code_module

SELECT 
  dim_presentation.code_presentation, 
  SUM(agg_pres_week_activity.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
  dim_presentation
JOIN 
  agg_pres_week_activity ON dim_presentation.presentation_key = agg_pres_week_activity.presentation_key
WHERE 
  dim_presentation.code_module = 'BBB'
GROUP BY 
  dim_presentation.code_presentation

SELECT a.activity_type, SUM(av.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM dim_activity a
JOIN agg_pres_week_activity av ON a.activity_key = av.activity_key
GROUP BY a.activity_type
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    a.activity_group, 
    SUM(aw.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    dim_activity a
JOIN 
    agg_pres_week_activity aw ON a.activity_key = aw.activity_key
WHERE 
    aw.presentation_key = (SELECT presentation_key FROM dim_presentation WHERE module_presentation = 'FFF-2013J')
    AND a.activity_group != 'none'
GROUP BY 
    a.activity_group

SELECT 
  cw.week_num, 
  SUM(aw.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
  dim_course_week cw
JOIN 
  agg_pres_week_activity apwa ON cw.week_key = apwa.week_key
JOIN 
  dim_presentation p ON apwa.presentation_key = p.presentation_key
WHERE 
  p.code_presentation = 'DDD-2013B' 
  AND cw.week_num BETWEEN 1 AND 10
GROUP BY 
  cw.week_num

SELECT code_presentation, COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM dim_enrollment
WHERE code_module = 'AAA'
GROUP BY code_presentation

SELECT 
  code_module, 
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS withdrawal_rate
FROM 
  dim_enrollment
GROUP BY 
  code_module

SELECT final_result, COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM dim_enrollment
WHERE code_presentation = 'CCC-2014J'
GROUP BY final_result

SELECT 
  dim_presentation.code_module, 
  ROUND(AVG(fact_assessment_submission.score), 1) AS avg_tma_score
FROM 
  fact_assessment_submission
JOIN 
  dim_assessment ON fact_assessment_submission.assessment_key = dim_assessment.assessment_key
JOIN 
  dim_presentation ON fact_assessment_submission.presentation_key = dim_presentation.presentation_key
WHERE 
  dim_assessment.assessment_type = 'TMA' 
  AND fact_assessment_submission.is_banked = 0
GROUP BY 
  dim_presentation.code_module

SELECT 
    a.assessment_type, 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fs.is_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(fs.submission_key) * 100, 1) AS percentage
FROM 
    dim_assessment a
JOIN 
    fact_assessment_submission fs ON a.assessment_key = fs.assessment_key
GROUP BY 
    a.assessment_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_key) 
FROM fact_vle_weekly 
WHERE presentation_key = (SELECT presentation_key FROM dim_presentation WHERE code_presentation = 'BBB-2014J') 
  AND week_key = 1 
  AND activity_key = (SELECT activity_key FROM dim_activity WHERE activity_type = 'forumng')

SELECT 
    p.code_presentation,
    ROUND(SUM(aw.total_clicks) / COUNT(e.enrollment_key), 1) AS avg_clicks_per_student
FROM 
    dim_presentation p
JOIN 
    agg_enrollment_week aw ON p.presentation_key = aw.presentation_key
JOIN 
    dim_enrollment e ON aw.enrollment_key = e.enrollment_key
WHERE 
    p.code_module = 'EEE' AND p.pres_year = 2014 AND p.pres_term = 'J' AND aw.week_key BETWEEN 1 AND 4
GROUP BY 
    p.code_presentation

SELECT 
  p.code_presentation, 
  SUM(e.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
  dim_presentation p
JOIN 
  agg_enrollment_week e ON p.presentation_key = e.presentation_key
WHERE 
  p.code_module = 'GGG' AND e.week_key <= 0
GROUP BY 
  p.code_presentation

SELECT 
    p.code_presentation,
    SUM(a.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    dim_presentation p
JOIN 
    agg_pres_week_activity a ON p.presentation_key = a.presentation_key
JOIN 
    dim_activity d ON a.activity_key = d.activity_key
WHERE 
    p.code_module = 'CCC' 
    AND p.code_presentation IN ('2014B', '2014J') 
    AND d.activity_type = 'quiz'
GROUP BY 
    p.code_presentation

SELECT 
    e.outcome_group,
    ROUND(AVG(aw.total_clicks), 1) AS avg_total_clicks
FROM 
    dim_enrollment e
JOIN 
    agg_enrollment_week aw ON e.enrollment_key = aw.enrollment_key
WHERE 
    e.code_presentation = 'FFF-2014J' 
    AND aw.week_key BETWEEN 1 AND 4
GROUP BY 
    e.outcome_group

SELECT 
  p.module_presentation, 
  COUNT(e.student_key) AS zero_click_students
FROM 
  dim_presentation p
JOIN 
  dim_enrollment e ON p.presentation_key = e.presentation_key
JOIN 
  agg_enrollment_week aew ON e.enrollment_key = aew.enrollment_key AND aew.week_key = 1
WHERE 
  aew.total_clicks = 0
GROUP BY 
  p.module_presentation

SELECT ROUND(AVG(active_days), 2) AS avg_active_days
FROM fact_vle_weekly
WHERE week_key = 2 AND presentation_key = (SELECT presentation_key FROM dim_presentation WHERE code_presentation = 'BBB-2013J') AND sum_click > 0

SELECT 
  s.gender, 
  SUM(e.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
  dim_student s
JOIN 
  dim_enrollment e ON s.student_key = e.student_key
JOIN 
  agg_enrollment_week ew ON e.enrollment_key = ew.enrollment_key
GROUP BY 
  s.gender

SELECT highest_education, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM dim_enrollment
WHERE final_result = 'Distinction'
GROUP BY highest_education

SELECT 
    a.id_assessment,
    a.due_day,
    ROUND(AVG(fs.score), 1) AS mean_score
FROM 
    dim_assessment a
JOIN 
    fact_assessment_submission fs ON a.assessment_key = fs.assessment_key
WHERE 
    a.code_presentation = 'AAA-2013J' 
    AND fs.is_banked = 0
GROUP BY 
    a.id_assessment, a.due_day

SELECT 
  code_module, 
  code_presentation, 
  SUM(total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
  agg_pres_week_activity
GROUP BY 
  code_module, 
  code_presentation WITH ROLLUP

SELECT 
    p.module_presentation, 
    ROUND(SUM(e.total_clicks) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_key), 1) AS avg_clicks_per_student
FROM 
    dim_presentation p
JOIN 
    agg_enrollment_week e ON p.presentation_key = e.presentation_key
GROUP BY 
    p.module_presentation
ORDER BY 
    avg_clicks_per_student DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  dim_presentation.code_module, 
  dim_assessment.assessment_type, 
  COUNT(dim_assessment.assessment_key) AS count
FROM 
  dim_presentation
JOIN 
  dim_assessment ON dim_presentation.presentation_key = dim_assessment.presentation_key
GROUP BY 
  dim_presentation.code_module, 
  dim_assessment.assessment_type

SELECT 
    dim_presentation.code_module, 
    ROUND(AVG(fact_assessment_submission.days_from_due), 1) AS avg_days_late
FROM 
    fact_assessment_submission
JOIN 
    dim_presentation ON fact_assessment_submission.presentation_key = dim_presentation.presentation_key
WHERE 
    fact_assessment_submission.is_late = 1
GROUP BY 
    dim_presentation.code_module

SELECT 
    c.phase, 
    SUM(a.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    dim_course_week c
JOIN 
    agg_pres_week_activity a ON c.week_key = a.week_key
GROUP BY 
    c.phase

SELECT COUNT(enrollment_key)
FROM agg_enrollment_week
WHERE presentation_key = (SELECT presentation_key FROM dim_presentation WHERE code_presentation = 'DDD-2014J')
  AND week_key IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
GROUP BY enrollment_key
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT week_key) = 4

SELECT 
  num_of_prev_attempts, 
  COUNT(*) AS count, 
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS percentage
FROM 
  dim_enrollment
GROUP BY 
  num_of_prev_attempts

SELECT 
  a.activity_group, 
  ROUND(SUM(av.total_clicks) / SUM(av.total_clicks) * 100, 1) AS percentage
FROM 
  dim_activity a
JOIN 
  agg_pres_week_activity av ON a.activity_key = av.activity_key
WHERE 
  a.activity_group != 'none'
GROUP BY 
  a.activity_group

SELECT final_result, ROUND(AVG(studied_credits), 1) AS avg_studied_credits
FROM dim_enrollment
GROUP BY final_result

SELECT 
    p.term_name, 
    SUM(a.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    dim_presentation p
JOIN 
    agg_pres_week_activity a ON p.presentation_key = a.presentation_key
WHERE 
    p.pres_term IN ('B', 'J')
GROUP BY 
    p.term_name

SELECT code_module, COUNT(*) AS distinction_count
FROM dim_enrollment
WHERE final_result = 'Distinction' AND pres_year = 2014
GROUP BY code_module

SELECT 
    a.activity_group,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_num = 1 THEN e.total_clicks ELSE 0 END), 0) AS week1,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_num = 2 THEN e.total_clicks ELSE 0 END), 0) AS week2,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_num = 3 THEN e.total_clicks ELSE 0 END), 0) AS week3
FROM 
    dim_activity a
JOIN 
    agg_pres_week_activity e ON a.activity_key = e.activity_key
JOIN 
    dim_course_week w ON e.week_key = w.week_key
WHERE 
    e.presentation_key = (SELECT presentation_key FROM dim_presentation WHERE code_module = 'AAA' AND code_presentation = '2014J')
GROUP BY 
    a.activity_group

SELECT 
    p.module_presentation,
    ROUND(AVG(s.score), 1) AS average_score
FROM 
    dim_presentation p
JOIN 
    fact_assessment_submission s ON p.presentation_key = s.presentation_key
JOIN 
    dim_assessment a ON s.assessment_key = a.assessment_key
WHERE 
    a.assessment_type = 'Exam'
GROUP BY 
    p.module_presentation

SELECT 
    p.module_presentation, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_key) AS student_count
FROM 
    dim_presentation p
JOIN 
    fact_assessment_submission s ON p.presentation_key = s.presentation_key
WHERE 
    s.is_late = 1
GROUP BY 
    p.module_presentation

SELECT 
    e.outcome_group, 
    SUM(a.total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM 
    dim_enrollment e
JOIN 
    agg_pres_week_activity a ON e.presentation_key = a.presentation_key
JOIN 
    dim_activity d ON a.activity_key = d.activity_key
WHERE 
    e.code_presentation = 'BBB-2014B' 
    AND d.activity_type = 'oucontent'
GROUP BY 
    e.outcome_group

SELECT MAX(sum_click) AS max_clicks
FROM fact_vle_weekly
WHERE code_presentation = 'FFF-2014J'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT activity_key) AS distinct_activity_types
FROM agg_pres_week_activity
WHERE code_presentation = 'GGG-2014J' AND total_clicks > 0

SELECT code_module, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count
FROM dim_enrollment
WHERE date_registration < -100
GROUP BY code_module

SELECT 
  e.final_result, 
  ROUND(AVG(aw.total_clicks), 1) AS avg_total_clicks
FROM 
  dim_enrollment e
JOIN 
  agg_enrollment_week aw ON e.enrollment_key = aw.enrollment_key
WHERE 
  e.code_module = 'CCC'
GROUP BY 
  e.final_result
